bibl.title: Not a Roman Trial of Christians: A Reassessment of P.Mil.Vogl. VI 287.
bibl.seg: Anna Dolganov & Éric Rebillard, Not a Roman Trial of Christians: A Reassessment of P.Mil.Vogl. VI 287.
Journal of Late Antiquity 14 (2021) pp. 177-212, figg.
bibl.note: Response to: Sabine R. Huebner, Soter, Sotas, and Dioscorus before the Governor: The First Authentic Court Record of a Roman Trial of Christians?, Journal of Late Antiquity 12 (2019) pp. 2-24. - A "Roman trial of Christians"? An evaluation of Huebner's arguments. - The hearing in P. Mil. Vogl. VI, 287: not a trial of Christians but the prosecution of an official. - Revised text and translation of P. Mil. Vogl. VI, 287. - Conclusion. - Appendix: a possible link between P. Mil. Vogl. II, 54 and a family archive from Tebtynis. - Palaeographical comparison of P. Mil. II, 54 and VI, 287.
